description: This file contains implementation of port management functions for an OpenMAX IL component, including port initialization, enabling, disabling, flushing, and buffer handling for a Samsung device's multimedia framework.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_FlushPort
methods.description: Flushes the specified port, handling queued buffers, signaling, and resetting port state.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_BufferFlushProcess
methods.description: Performs buffer flush on a specified port, including signaling, buffer handling, and callback notification.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_BufferFlushProcessNoEvent
methods.description: Performs buffer flush without sending event notifications, mainly for internal cleanup.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_EnablePort
methods.description: Enables a port, allocating tunnel buffers if necessary, and updating port state.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_PortEnableProcess
methods.description: Enables one or all ports, invoking SEC_OMX_EnablePort and signaling completion.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_DisablePort
methods.description: Disables a port, freeing tunnel buffers if needed, and updating port state.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_PortDisableProcess
methods.description: Disables one or all ports, performing flush and signaling events.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_EmptyThisBuffer
methods.description: Handles input buffer submission, queues buffer, and signals processing.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_FillThisBuffer
methods.description: Handles output buffer submission, queues buffer, and signals processing.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_Port_Constructor
methods.description: Initializes port structures, creates queues, semaphores, and sets default port parameters.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_Port_Destructor
methods.description: Cleans up port resources, terminates queues and semaphores.
